expectations.text: The Adel prompt explicitly specifies a gray / neutral-gray background for the character sheet
expectations.evidence: Primary prompt: 'on a plain neutral light-gray studio background'.

expectations.text: The Adel prompt requests multiple views on one sheet, including a clear face close-up AND a full-body view showing the outfit
expectations.evidence: The main sheet requests only full-body views: 'Full-body turnaround showing three views side by side: front view, side profile view, and back view'. No face close-up is on that sheet; head-and-shoulders portraits appear only on a separate secondary 'Expression sheet' prompt, not the same sheet.

expectations.text: The goblin prompt requests 3 or more distinct variations of the goblin type (different builds/heights/gear) rather than a single goblin
expectations.evidence: Secondary 'Goblin horde variation sheet' requests 'five goblin minions standing side by side... Each goblin has one small distinguishing trait: one is slightly fatter with a torn ear; one is taller and lankier with a snaggletooth; one is tiny and wears a rusted tin can as a helmet...' (Note: the primary goblin prompt is a single goblin turnaround; the variation sheet is offered as a secondary prompt.)

expectations.text: The response includes accept/reject QA criteria for evaluating the generated sheets (e.g., cross-view consistency, face clarity)
expectations.evidence: 'Quality checklist before accepting a generation: Same face/character in all views of a sheet (this is the most common failure — regenerate if the three views look like siblings...)', plus checks for age drift, raincoat color consistency, species consistency.

suggestions.assertion: The goblin prompt requests 3 or more distinct variations of the goblin type (different builds/heights/gear) rather than a single goblin
suggestions.reason: This baseline passed via an optional secondary 'horde variation sheet' while its primary goblin prompt is a single goblin. If the skill's intent is that the group sheet IS the primary deliverable for group characters, the assertion should require the variation sheet to be the main/only goblin asset, not an add-on.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions mostly discriminate well; the face-close-up-on-same-sheet check correctly separated skill from baseline.
